description: This file contains data access functions for managing 'reminders' in a PostgreSQL database, including CRUD operations and conversion of database rows to API response format.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _row_to_reminder(row: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a database row to a reminder dictionary suitable for API responses.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] list_reminders( *, include_completed: bool = True, limit: int = 200, offset: int = 0 )
methods.description: Fetches a list of reminders from the database, optionally including completed reminders, with pagination.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_reminder(reminder_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder by its ID.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_reminder( *, title: str, description: Optional[str], due_date: datetime, notification_at: Optional[datetime], )
methods.description: Inserts a new reminder into the database and returns the created record.

methods.name: Tuple[str,List[Any]] _build_update_set_clause( updates: Dict[str, Any], )
methods.description: Builds SQL SET clause and parameter list for updating reminders.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] update_reminder( reminder_id: int, *, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, due_date: Optional[datetime] = None, notification_at: Optional[datetime] = None, )
methods.description: Updates specified fields of an existing reminder.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] set_completed(reminder_id: int, *, completed: bool)
methods.description: Updates the 'completed' status of a reminder.

methods.name: bool is_foreign_key_violation(exc: Exception)
methods.description: Checks whether an exception is a PostgreSQL foreign key violation.

ctags.name: create_reminder
ctags.signature: ( *, title: str, description: Optional[str], due_date: datetime, notification_at: Optional[datetime], )

ctags.name: list_reminders
ctags.signature: ( *, include_completed: bool = True, limit: int = 200, offset: int = 0 )

ctags.name: set_completed
ctags.pattern: /^def set_completed(reminder_id: int, *, completed: bool) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:$/

ctags.name: update_reminder
ctags.signature: ( reminder_id: int, *, title: Optional[str] = None, description: Optional[str] = None, due_date: Optional[datetime] = None, notification_at: Optional[datetime] = None, )
